finding.headline: "The Postpartum-Weight Mama (No Crash)"
finding.problem: "Everyone says 'lose the baby weight' but if I diet my milk drops and I'm dizzy. I want my body back without hurting my baby."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "Feeding the mother while she's feeding the baby"
finding.person: A 29-yr-old breastfeeding mum 8 weeks PP, pressured by "snap-back" photos, wants to lose weight safely without hurting supply; fears crash diets.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone — "Soft Landing: Safe Postpartum Weight Loss While Breastfeeding (African Plate Method)."". Verdict: PASSES (21/25)..
